aids.name: Session Plan
aids.description: A visual aid to facilitate meetings (face to face or virtual).

aids.name: Alignment of Priorities
aids.description: A visual aid to align priorities of key stakeholders.

aids.name: Priorities Map
aids.description: A visual aid to map and compare top of mind priorities for individual and organizational stakeholders.

aids.name: Criteria Proposition
aids.description: A visual aid to express the full worth of a solution to stakeholders.

aids.name: Assessment Roadmap
aids.description: A visual aid to assist stakeholders through their assessment (decision making) process.

aids.name: Assessment Questions
aids.description: A set of questions to assist stakeholders through their assessment (decision making) process.

aids.name: Assessment Snapshot
aids.description: A visual aid to summarize the key dimensions of success for an initiative or solution.

aids.name: Decision Criteria Map
aids.description: A visual aid to evaluate alternatives to select the best answer.

aids.name: Decision Criteria Matrix
aids.description: A visual aid to evaluate alternatives to select the best answer.

aids.name: Decision Matrix
aids.description: A visual aid to assist stakeholders through their decision making process.

aids.name: Dimensions of Success
aids.description: A visual aid to summarize the priorities, requirements, and criteria among stakeholders for an initiative or solution.

aids.name: Fast Path/Gap
aids.description: A visual aid to illustrate the different roads an initiative can take.

aids.name: Guiding Principles
aids.description: A visual aid to highlight a mind-set for healthy dialogues to make better business decisions.

aids.name: Initiative Assessment
aids.description: A visual aid to qualify an initiative with potential sponsors.

aids.name: Napkin
aids.description: A visual aid to compare contrasting approaches to making business decisions.

aids.name: Option Snapshot
aids.description: A visual aid to highlight potential solutions.

aids.name: PRC Notes
aids.description: A visual aid to qualify organizational strategies (from the set of possible solutions) based on their potential value and usage.

aids.name: Pros & Cons
aids.description: A visual aid to organize the positives and negatives for a given topic to make better decisions.

aids.name: Requirements Blueprint
aids.description: A visual aid to frame a set of high-level requirements to create meaningful and worthwhile outcomes (results).

aids.name: Rollout Timeline
aids.description: A visual aid to show the timing (delivery) for the major phases of an initiative or solution.

aids.name: Solution Snapshot
aids.description: A visual aid to highlight potential solutions.

aids.name: Solutions Map
aids.description: A visual aid to map the impact of capabilities to the top of mind initiatives of key stakeholders.

aids.name: Stakeholder Profile
aids.description: A visual aid to understand a stakeholder's role within a business and/or decision-making process.

aids.name: Strategy to Execution
aids.description: A visual aid to qualify organizational strategies (from the set of possible solutions) based on their potential value and usage.

aids.name: Three Column
aids.description: A visual aid to organize information and facilitate better decision making based on predefined KA attributes.

aids.name: Understanding Positions
aids.description: A visual aid to show the opposing positions of stakeholders to identify the common ground they share.

aids.name: Understanding a Problem
aids.description: A visual aid to accurately decompose and frame the key attributes of a business problem.

aids.name: Voting Map
aids.description: A visual aid to facilitate the voting (preference) for initiatives or solutions based on predefined KA criteria.

aids.name: 4 Box Grid
aids.description: A visual aid to place items against two axes, low to high.

aids.name: 9 Box Grid
aids.description: A visual aid to place items against two axes, low, medium and high.

aids.name: 4D Matrix
aids.description: A visual aid to show the relationships between groupings of items.

aids.name: SWOT
aids.description: A visual aid to show the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats to facilitate better decision making.

aids.name: Venn
aids.description: A visual aid to show the similarities and/or differences between three items/topics.
